parsed.notes:
WHAT’S REQUIRED supplies the technical qualifications; no heading marks a section optional. Python alone is marked preferred.
Statistical models and statistics collapse into one statistics criterion. Advanced modeling techniques is left unmapped rather than assuming AI model development.
Skills mentioned only in the company description or role responsibilities are excluded.
Seniority is inferred literally from the one-year minimum; the open-ended '+' does not state a senior level.
Masters/PhD takes the highest named degree, PhD.
